7185.title: Uninitialized SDK messages overwrite the Claude session identity
7185.rootCauseOneLine: Both session caches accept unannounced SDK message IDs; the bridge publishes them and reuses them for context probes and resume.

prReviews.verdict: Static review only; closed and unmerged
prReviews.topFinding: The diff targets pre-init attachment adoption but does not gate the SDK session cache.

7185.proposedFix: Accept identity changes only on system/init and use the retained attachment identity for context probes. Gate both caches and protect restart plus outgoing-prompt behavior.
7185.caveats: No live macOS wake/network reproduction. Local candidate not pushed: six existing provider tests fail on both baseline and candidate. Reproduction patch and evidence are inline in the self-contained HTML; raw artifacts remain local.
